label: D2 after a rare a2->S1 transition, on repeated-a2 trials, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the agent chose a2 and landed in S1 (the rare a2 transition): 100% of activations satisfy D2 & action==2 & state==1, so it reads in_action=a2 together with in_state=S1. Never fires at D1/GO, on a1 trials, on common transitions, or on rare a1->S2. Within that set it is gated by episode position: essentially silent after trial ~50 of the episode (rate falls off over trials 30-50), and mostly on trials that repeat the previous a2 choice (almost never right after a switch to a2) while S2 is the good state. Recorded predicate uses only variables observable at D2 (action, state, stay) plus the hidden good state and ep_trial; dev F1 0.79 (P 0.71, R 0.89, mass recall 0.92). The simpler D2 & a2 & S1 & ep_trial<40 gets F1 0.73. Magnitude is higher when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 captures 80% of the mass but only 76% of the activations), and top examples are rare a2->S1 trials inside a run of a2 choices with S2 good. The ep_trial cutoff probably stands in for some slow drift in hidden state rather than a clean variable.
